description: Git access to a custom theme's code: the HTTPS remote and a repo-scoped token (read, or write on the Pro plan). Pushes to main compile automatically and, for the live theme, publish once compiled; theme_get shows a push that failed to compile as push_error. Tokens expire (default 1 hour).

theme_id.description: A theme id from theme_list (or a system theme id: lokand-base, lokand-one)

name: theme_git_access
title: Theme git access
